decisions.reason: Although only briefly mentioned on the website and distant from the established offer, sunk launch investments and management responsibility create escalation pressures that make dropping unlikely this early.
With a dedicated web page and a basis in the firm's established offer, public commitment and the need to justify prior investments strengthen the case for keeping the product.
The dedicated page and fit with the firm's energy-efficient lighting direction create visible commitment, so escalation of commitment favors persistence despite any disappointing early results.
As a relaunch of a popular designer task light close to the core offer, public commitment and sunk costs are high, making dropping highly unlikely under escalation of commitment.
